stressCase: An RSR spatial-audio event must preserve its authoritative tick and integer spatial parameters while crossing one explicit Studio binding into two target hosts, with missing bindings/listeners remaining observable blocks rather than inferred assets or listeners.
donorAdvantage: RSR already owns deterministic spatial-audio events and listener snapshots; Studio already owns sealed content-addressed asset/file records; the candidate reuses both seams and the existing Android synthetic-origin WebView host instead of creating native or duplicate semantic registries.
regressionCase: Unbound cues remain blocked-binding, invalid or missing listener policy cannot select a listener, exact file role/MIME/hash checks remain fail-closed, and projects without an audio profile retain only the explicitly named legacy procedural fallback.
boundaries: This demonstrates target Provider parameter application and receipt generation, not audible output.
The Chromium run reports an AudioContext user-gesture warning; the Android result is an API 35 Emulator/WebView execution, not a physical-device audio result.
Equal-power panning, linear distance and occlusion low-pass are the current candidate mapping, not perceptual equivalence or production mixing policy.
No native audio backend, speaker/headphone routing, latency curve, concurrency/mixing quality, streaming, release signing, store delivery or human listening acceptance is claimed.
No K400 gate is promoted to PASS.
